brochure.identity: FLIRT Electric Low-Floor Multiple Unit, Koleje Mazowieckie, Poland

analysis.description: User supplied secondary analysis, dated 2026-10-17; tables and all paragraphs extracted. Contains quoted original case inputs, inferred results and explicitly provisional technical extensions.

vehicle.identity: Stadler FLIRT for Koleje Mazowieckie, Poland
vehicle.cars_evidence: Brochure side/plan drawing has two end cars and three intermediate cars; DOCX case says five cars.
visible_architecture: Sloped rounded cab ends at both ends; broad dark windscreen with upper destination screen.
Two double sliding passenger doors per car per side, giving ten door openings per side. Cab access door additional.
Six bogies: one motor bogie near each cab, four shared trailer bogies at articulations.
Four narrow black flexible gangways between car bodies.
Visible roof equipment including HVAC, electrical boxes and pantograph equipment. Two pantographs appear on the first intermediate car in side drawing; precise equipment placement not dimensioned.
White exterior with green side/cab panels and yellow passenger doors in the actual Polish rendering. Using blue palette is intentional visual restyling.
Black window band, individual rounded rectangular windows, end coupling assembly, recessed headlights.
geometry_limits: No 3D CAD/GLB or dimensioned cross sections are supplied.
Per-car lengths, cab/nose coordinates, roof curvature, wall thickness, door/window longitudinal coordinates and equipment CAD are not supplied.
Architectural reconstruction can match five-car layout, overall dimensions, bogie arrangement and visible proportions; an exact production geometry replica cannot be certified from this brochure.
Brochure is standard-gauge Polish 3 kV DC equipment, not proof of Kazakhstan gauge, supply or climate certification.
vehicle.fleet_number_note: Page 1 describes framework for 71 units; page 2 table says number of vehicles 61. These refer to procurement quantities and are not car count per train.

case_inputs_from_analysis_docx.40_years_status: Optional extension from oral comment, not mandatory case horizon.

financial_model.meaning: 357 MWh/year is A versus B difference, not total energy of either train. Absolute train demand cannot be recovered from the supplied figures.
financial_model.timing: First year tariff is 1.2; first increase starts in year 2. Baseline payback is within year 1, so yearly escalation does not change it.
limits: Does not include maintenance, financing, tax, residual value, manufacturing, material sourcing or disposal.
Changing baseline delta energy by +/-10% is sensitivity, not a measured weather response.
Do not derive baseline annual kWh directly from mass or change 357 MWh with unsupported weather multipliers.

chemistry_and_environment.confirmed_temperature_envelope: Not provided in either supplied file. -50 to +50 C is the user requested scenario control, not a proven operating envelope for this FLIRT.
chemistry_and_environment.humidity: No measured RH range, HVAC humidity response or corrosion calibration supplied.

chemical_mentions.aluminium_groups: ISO 15608 groups 22 and 23 discussed as provisional categories, not confirmed actual Stadler grades.
chemical_mentions.steel_groups: ISO 15608 1.2 and 2.1 are provisional discussion categories.
chemical_mentions.helium_argon: Possible aluminium welding shielding gas choices. Actual use by Stadler, ratio, flow, import provenance and costs not confirmed.
chemical_mentions.weather_exposure: Moisture, temperature cycles and deicing reagents appear as factors, but no pollutant concentrations or validated formulas supplied.

chemistry_and_environment.ui_recommendation: Temperature and humidity sliders can drive clearly labeled visualization scenarios. Mg/Mn/Si/Zn and Ar/He sliders, if offered, must sit in an explicit experimental material/process panel with illustrative values and no claim of Stadler alloy certification. Ar/He is a fabrication process scenario, not ambient weather. Do not show invented concentrations as sourced facts.
named_missing_inputs: Exact alloy grade and chemical composition certificate
Monthly HVAC demand for both train alternatives

conflicts_and_separation: Brochure maximum speed 160 km/h and assignment maximum speed 140 km/h are distinct; do not silently replace one with the other.
Brochure is actual aluminium FLIRT; steel comparator is hypothetical case, not a supplied equivalent product drawing.
145/180 t are whole-train case masses, not carbody-only material masses.
Aluminium does not automatically reduce heating demand; HVAC differences are unknown.
-50 to +50 C visualization is not safety qualification or manufacturer certification.
